description: Feedback intake for an external app repo: import an in-app /feedback export into {{workdir}}/docs/intake/{{project}}/raw/ → Hana (product-manager, Intake mode) triages each new item into an intake file + queue.md (checked by check-intake.js) → architect (Opus) reviews work orders of route:full items → owner gate: mark items approved/rejected in queue.md. Approved items then run with the Start command in their intake file (quick-fix / app-build). Vars: workdir (app checkout), project (slug), export (.txt paste or .json).

stages.task: Use 'Intake mode' from your agent file. Process every file in {{workdir}}/docs/intake/{{project}}/raw/ that has no intake file yet: write one intake file per item in {{workdir}}/docs/intake/{{project}}/ (<id>-<slug>.md), then write or update {{workdir}}/docs/intake/{{project}}/queue.md listing every item with its route and status. Do not touch items that already have an intake file.

Only for items with 'route: full' in {{workdir}}/docs/intake/{{project}}/*.md (skip queue.md and raw/): review the work order for task order and parallel-task file conflicts, and edit the intake file in place to fix them. If there are no route: full items, change nothing.

stages.title: {{project}}: Owner: mark items approved/rejected in queue.md (or reply in chat).
